evidence: The current KiCad physical authority and generated Gerber Job declare ENIG and black top/bottom solder mask.
config/requirements.json and config/product-decisions.json require JLCPCB SMT assembly for the first prototype.
https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities/: fabrication capability depends on the selected solder-mask color and process.
https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/Capabilities?type=1 lines 201-202: multilayer 1 oz minimum track/spacing 0.09/0.09 mm.
https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/Capabilities?type=1 lines 217-218: SMD pad-to-pad minimum 0.15 mm; the reviewed 0.20 mm board default preserves margin for USB-C fine pitch.
config/jlcpcb-impedance-evidence.json: JLC04161H-3313A USB pair uses the manufacturer-calculated 0.290576 mm base width and 0.2032 mm gap over In1.Cu.

usb_connector_fanout.scope: Connector-side J1-to-U2 nets only; never applies after U2.

cost_review.rule: Never hard-code a vendor price. Every non-standard selected process needs evidence and a lower-cost alternative or an explicit required decision; every live quote line must map back to one reviewed driver.

drivers.reason: The adopted board contains 0.20 mm vias; changing this order option without a board revision would violate the released drill data.
drivers.lower_cost_alternative: On the next board revision, trial 0.30 mm drills and larger via pads before routing congestion is accepted.

drivers.reason: The reviewed electrical requirement explicitly requires a 90-ohm USB differential design and the routed geometry is bound to the selected manufacturer stack.
drivers.lower_cost_alternative: A future cost-down review may waive paid impedance control only with a documented SI/risk decision; geometry and a continuous reference plane still remain mandatory.

drivers.reason: ENIG provides a planar RoHS finish for the fine-pitch USB-C footprint and the castellated ESP32 module used on the first article.
drivers.lower_cost_alternative: Evaluate lead-free HASL against the exact fine-pitch footprints and assembly process; do not silently substitute it at order time.

drivers.reason: Black solder mask is a reviewed product appearance choice, not an electrical requirement.
drivers.lower_cost_alternative: Use the vendor's standard green solder mask when prototype cost is more important than appearance, then rerun DFM with green-mask capabilities.

drivers.reason: The released USB geometry was calculated against this reviewed stack; choosing another material invalidates the impedance evidence.
drivers.lower_cost_alternative: For the next revision, start with the calculator's lowest-cost standard stack before fixing trace geometry.

drivers.selection: epoxy-filled and capped vias where pad proximity requires it
drivers.reason: The adopted geometry contains vias in or within 0.35 mm of paste-bearing pads; ordinary ink plugging is not a reliable anti-wicking treatment.
drivers.lower_cost_alternative: Move ordinary return vias clear of pads and redesign the U1 thermal-via construction before the next routing freeze.

drivers.reason: This is accepted only when it is an unavoidable vendor order line rather than an optional electrical test.
drivers.lower_cost_alternative: None if the vendor confirms the line is mandatory; otherwise deselect it and regenerate the quote.

drivers.reason: This board has no reviewed milliohm or Kelvin-resistance acceptance requirement.
drivers.lower_cost_alternative: Use normal continuity/e-test included with fabrication.

drivers.reason: No reviewed copper-thickness or special via-plating requirement exists beyond the standard four-layer fabrication capability.
drivers.lower_cost_alternative: Use the standard via copper process unless current-capacity evidence explicitly requires otherwise.

drivers.reason: An opaque surcharge cannot be approved without the vendor identifying the triggering process and its design requirement.
drivers.lower_cost_alternative: Ask the vendor to identify the source option, then map it to a reviewed driver or remove it.

open_0p20mm_vias_near_smt_pads.component: All open 0.20 mm drill vias, including the 18 unique vias whose drill area intersects an SMT paste-bearing pad
open_0p20mm_vias_near_smt_pads.reason: The exact adopted board has 20 vendor-style PIN-to-hole intersections representing 18 unique same-net open vias. They are electrically safe but ordinary unfilled construction can wick solder; JLCPCB states that vias in pads or less than 0.35 mm from pads require epoxy or copper filling rather than ink plugging.

u1_thermal_holes.reason: Gerber and Excellon cannot prove that the 12 under-module holes receive the intended anti-wicking treatment. Confirm the order/CAM treatment before release.

notes: Selection records provenance only. Run apply_reviewed_fab_values.py after independent review before real routing.
The listed 0.20 mm default is a manufacturability rule, not an approval for high-current power copper. Power-net geometry requires its own reviewed current-capacity evidence.
